title: feuilleea trinervia
intro: Feuilleea trinervia, commonly known as 'Three-veined Rue', is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Feuilleea trinervia include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include limonoids and coumarins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and antihistamine effects.
